notes: PERIOD: every page prints "CALENDAR YEAR: 2025, QUARTER: 3", but the utilization runs through OCTOBER, NOVEMBER and DECEMBER 2025, so this is the year-end (Q4) report with a stale quarter heading. period.quarter is kept at 4 (asOf 2025-12-31) per the catalog and the content; period.printed records the printed heading.

This is Part II of a two-part report and continues 2025-q4-ldrrmf-part-1 directly. Part II prints no Section A (Sources of Funds), so it has no sources table and summary.totalAvailable/qrf/mitigation are null. Part I prints Total Funds Available 412,571,024.80 (QRF 54,029,533.50; Mitigation 358,541,491.30); the Part II balances are consistent with it (412,571,024.80 - 183,872,593.81 = 228,698,430.99; 358,541,491.30 - 183,872,593.81 = 174,668,897.49).

The printed Total Utilization 183,872,593.81 covers the whole report (Parts I and II): Part I items (117,476,224.92) + Part II items (66,396,368.89) = 183,872,593.81 exactly. The utilization total in this file therefore does not equal the sum of this file's items alone.

The first nine rows (page 1 and the top of page 2) continue the CONTINUING AND CURRENT APPROPRIATION list from Part I, whose last printed month heading is SEPTEMBER; their month is inferred as SEPTEMBER, not printed on this part. Later month headings (OCTOBER, NOVEMBER, DECEMBER, and the TRUST FUND months) are printed.

All utilization amounts are printed in the Mitigation Fund 70% column; the QRF, NDRRM, Other LGUs, Other Sources and Total columns are blank on every utilization row. Total Utilization prints "-" for QRF.
Particulars are transcribed as printed, including typos and truncations ("ayment", "tamapus", "compesation", "cityincluding", "repair of repair", "unts", "Assisstance", "evacutaion", "trag").
